filter_note: V1 set (7) + market briefing + AI news; Today window = Wed Nov 4 – Thu Nov 5 PT

market_briefing.lede: Platform vendors spent Nov 4 scaling agent ops and grounding: OpenAI published an autonomous pipeline that validated and patched hundreds of Linux privilege-escalation bugs, Meta bought multi-agent coding startup Conductor, and Google expanded its Agentic Data Cloud so agents can query Iceberg data across clouds — including zero-copy paths to Salesforce — under a shared Knowledge Catalog.

bullets.text: Nov 4: OpenAI said a mid-October run of its upcoming cyber model dynamically reproduced 1,724 Linux kernel vulnerabilities and produced 948 working local privilege-escalation exploits plus candidate patches, at about $1.2M in API cost; findings are being reported with Patch the Planet partners.

Nov 4: Meta acquired Conductor, an AI coding product for running multiple coding agents in parallel workspaces; Conductor Cloud shuts down Nov 20, with the local app supported into early 2027. Deal terms undisclosed.

Nov 4: Google Cloud expanded the Agentic Data Cloud — Gemini on the borderless Lakehouse, Knowledge Catalog self-learning enrichment (preview), AlloyDB direct Iceberg access, and Data Agent Kit GA — with zero-copy / federation paths that include Salesforce, SAP, and Workday.

biggest_ai_news.title: OpenAI publishes an autonomous Linux vulnerability discovery, exploit, and patching pipeline
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 4: mid-October run with an upcoming cyber model reproduced 1,724 vulns and generated 948 LPE exploits plus patches (~$1.21M API cost); ≥10 novel exploitation techniques claimed in a sampled set. OpenAI is upstreaming critical patches via Patch the Planet.

biggest_ai_news.title: Meta acquires Conductor
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 4: Conductor (multi-agent parallel coding workspaces; agents from Anthropic/OpenAI) joins Meta. Cloud product winds down by Nov 20; local app continues to early 2027. Terms not disclosed.

biggest_ai_news.title: Google expands Agentic Data Cloud for production agents
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 4: borderless Lakehouse + Knowledge Catalog upgrades, AlloyDB↔Iceberg, Spanner Omni GA, AlloyDB Express preview, BigQuery Graph GA, TimesFM 3.0 / TabFM preview. Named customers include PayPal, Siemens, Walmart.

biggest_ai_news.title: NVIDIA CUDA 13.5 GA with Vera Rubin support
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 4: production Vera Rubin GPU support, MPS v3, CUDA Tile multi-GPU, Nsight Perf SDK for AI preview.

OpenAI (Nov 4) published results of an autonomous Linux vuln pipeline (948 LPEs, ~$1.2M API cost). Meta (Nov 4) acquired Conductor; Cloud sunsets Nov 20. Google (Nov 4) expanded Agentic Data Cloud / Knowledge Catalog. NVIDIA (Nov 4) shipped CUDA 13.5 with Vera Rubin GA. No new watchlist launch/funding/M&A beyond Nov 4 items already covered yesterday. interpretation.note: Interpretation: After a heavy watchlist day on Nov 4, the market's next moves are governance and grounding — evals, cost caps, and shared context catalogs — more than another sales-assistant launch. Salesloft leaving Agentic Playbook in early access through a named summit suggests pricing/GA is still being staged, not slipped live.
